prompt:
Assess ISO readiness for: Industry: Cement Manufacturing, Company Size: 800 employees, Pain Points: Kiln dust emissions exceeding permit 2x/quarter, noise exposure in grinding area, no life-cycle perspective for environmental aspects, community relations strained

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore": "Moderate", "gaps": "Current systems lack integrated environmental management, exposure control measures, life-cycle assessment protocols, and community engagement frameworks. Kiln dust management and noise control are reactive rather than preventive, with no formal environmental policy aligning operations to sustainability goals.", "recommendations": "Implement ISO 14001 for systematic environmental management focusing on kiln dust reduction through real-time monitoring and emission control upgrades. Introduce ISO 45001 to address noise exposure via engineering controls and worker rotation. Develop life-cycle assessment protocols aligned with ISO 14040/14044 for raw material sourcing to energy use. Establish a community relations program under ISO 26000 guidelines, including transparent reporting and stakeholder dialogue to rebuild trust.", "standards": "ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety), ISO 14040/14044 (Life Cycle Assessment), ISO 26000 (Social Responsibility Guidelines)"}
